# uzc_vpn_customer_gateway (Resource)

Manages a UzCloud VPN customer gateway. PUT /vpn-customer-gateways/{slug} accepts the same field set as create, so every attribute here is mutable in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_vpn_customer_gateway" "example" {
  name                = "example-customer-gateway"
  gateway             = "203.0.113.1"
  cidr_list           = "192.168.0.0/24"
  ipsec_preshared_key = var.ipsec_preshared_key
  ike_lifetime        = 86400
  esp_lifetime        = 3600
  ike_encryption      = "aes256"
  ike_hash            = "sha256"
  ike_version         = "ikev2"
  ike_dh              = "modp1536"
  esp_encryption      = "aes256"
  esp_hash            = "sha256"
  esp_pfs             = "modp1536"
  cloud_provider      = "nimbo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr_list` (String) Allowed CIDR ranges for VPN traffic.
- `cloud_provider` (String)
- `esp_encryption` (String)
- `esp_hash` (String)
- `esp_lifetime` (Number) ESP session validity duration, in seconds.
- `esp_pfs` (String) PFS group used for ESP.
- `gateway` (String) The gateway IP through which VPN traffic is routed.
- `ike_dh` (String) Diffie-Hellman group for IKE negotiations.
- `ike_encryption` (String)
- `ike_hash` (String)
- `ike_lifetime` (Number) IKE session validity duration, in seconds.
- `ike_version` (String)
- `ipsec_preshared_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `dead_peer_detection` (Boolean)
- `force_encapsulation` (Boolean)
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset.
- `split_connections` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_vpn_customer_gateway.example <customer-gateway-slug>
```
